description: Brovi E3372-325 (sold as Huawei E3372h-325; VID 3566, not Huawei's 12d1) in its HiLink build: router inside the stick, RNDIS/Ethernet function with a web UI at 192.168.8.1, so the HiLink owner. Neither Linux 6.12 nor master lists VID 3566 in option or qmi_wwan, OpenWrt's usb-modeswitch data has no entry for it, and ModemManager's Huawei plugin takes VID 12d1 only. Field reports on OpenWrt: the stick comes up as rndis_host, gets an address, then resets into a mass-storage (CD-ROM) only identity; a manual usb_modeswitch on 3566:2001 plus an option new_id gave three ttys and a cdc_ncm function (that stick mode is left to generic-ncm here; no automatic switch or new_id). Not the older E3372h-153/-320 (12d1:1f01 -> 14db/14dc HiLink, 1506 stick). Reference only, no field report of ours. Sources: OpenWrt forum topic 153556 'Huawei e3372h-325 ... stuck in CDROM only mode' and Armbian forum topic 28692 (read through a web search summary, not in full); Linux 6.12 and master option.c / qmi_wwan.c; OpenWrt usb-mode.json; ModemManager 1.25.95 src/plugins/huawei/mm-plugin-huawei.c
